title: Coverage grid cells: two check-ins on one day from two phones (check, two devices), a check edited after its period ended (check, edited after settled), a ticked pay's amount corrected (settle, edited after settled)
story: A couple, one shared copy. Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000, of which Free to spend 50,000 (typed). Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier). Fri 8 Jan: Jun checks in on his phone at 09:00 (296,000) and Tess on hers at 18:00 (293,000); the later one's stretch starts at the earlier one. Mon 25 Jan the pay is ticked as 250,000; later the amount is corrected to 252,000 (the record is the same, edited). In February Tess also corrects her 8 Jan figure from 294,000 to 293,000: an edit of a check in a period that has ended, which does not touch the new period. Tue 26 Jan check-in: 540,000. Every amount is made up.
